response: The combination with 2-methoxyestradiol (2ME) is able to enhance the antiproliferative activity of certain chemotherapeutics at pharmacologically relevant concentrations. This suggests that 2ME may be able to reduce the dosages of chemotherapeutics needed in the treatment of human ovarian cancer, potentially offering a new clinically relevant treatment regimen for hormone-dependent cancer. However, it is essential to note that 2ME is currently being investigated in clinical trials, specifically in patients with refractory metastatic breast cancer, and its efficacy and safety in ovarian cancer treatment are still being researched.
